d=$(mktemp -d); cd "$d"; /bin/sh -c 'echo $$ >p1; (until test -e release; do /bin/sleep .01; done; echo C1 >>log) & echo $! >hC1; kill -KILL $$' | /bin/sh -c 'until test -e go2; do /bin/sleep .01; done; echo $$ >p2; (until test -e release; do /bin/sleep .01; done; echo C2 >>log) & echo $! >hC2; kill -KILL $$' & p=$!; until [ -s p1 ] && [ -s hC1 ]; do :; done; read a <p1; read ha <hC1; dead $a; touch go2; until [ -s p2 ] && [ -s hC2 ]; do :; done; read b <p2; read hb <hC2; dead $b; echo NEXT; touch release; dead $ha; dead $hb; wait "$p"; echo wait=$?; sort log; cd /; rm -rf "$d"
